videos.title: How to effectively COUNTER the PRESS in Armwrestling
videos.summary:
What is the single most effective way to shut down a presser? With the press being the talk of the town right now, I break down exactly how to take it away.

In this one I look at what a presser actually wants at the table, from their foot position and body contact to locking the forearm tight against the bicep with a neutral hand, and why a press in its lane delivers more force than any other style. Then I go through the counters in order: denying center, the wrist flexion and cupping that turns off their rotation, and the low grip that shuts down the flop press. I also look at how some of the best pullers in the world have shut down top pressers.

What's in this one:
- What a presser is trying to achieve: the shoulder roll and the flop press
- Denying center as the first and simplest counter
- Why cupping and wrist flexion are the most important counters to the press
- How taking away neutral rotation turns off a presser's finishing power
- Why leading with pronation is the weakest counter
- Using a low grip and base power to deny the flop press
- What to do when a presser gets the jump on you off the go

How do you deal with pressers? Tell me in the comments.
